title: l1qw.20.3: Rust: persist claim_seq high-water across restarts
description: Rust slot.rs:515 replay check uses ephemeral HashMap. On restart, all claim_seq history is lost, allowing replay of old claims. Wire to lichen-hal FileStorage or equivalent persistence for the per-gateway (superframe_id, claim_sequence) tuple. Sender side: atomic increment-before-claim per R-09-xxx.

Sender-side atomic increment-before-claim remains tracked separately under parent l1qw.20. No code change needed for this bead; closing as already-implemented.
